fields.headline: Cyber 1 Incident Declared
fields.narration: Dr. Pruitt, County IT is ready to isolate MCHD-INT01 and the IIS export interface. But the same server carries the electronic lab results from KDHE: if we isolate it, new measles lab results come only by phone and fax, and MCHD-FAX01 is not trusted either. If we keep it online, the script keeps changing data. What is the order?
keyFacts: MCHD-INT01 and IIS export interface (10.72.14.22) are now isolated from the county network.
The IIS export file is officially 'not trusted' and must not be used for state reporting.
The Epi team must now operate solely from paper records and DOC laptops on LTE hotspots.
KDHE is no longer receiving data from MCHD; new case reports must be received via phone or email.
The Policy Group has been formally notified per C15 and C12.
fields.expectedAction: DECISION POINT: the HO decides isolation (with County IT, which owns the network decision) and the fallback for lab results (Disease Reporting Line, KDHE fax number, MCHD-F-10); declares Cyber 1 if not yet done and informs the Policy Group.
fields.facilitatorNote: This inject confirms the formal declaration of Cyber 1. The team must now transition to full paper mode and begin public messaging. Watch for the Epi team to request the line list from the DOC kit.

fields.headline: Cyber 1 Incident Declared
fields.narration: The Incident Commander has formally declared a Cyber 1 incident. All network traffic to and from MCHD-INT01 (10.72.14.22) and the IIS export interface has been isolated. The IIS export file is now marked 'not trusted' on the DOC status board. The Epi team has been directed to operate exclusively from paper records and the two DOC laptops on LTE hotspots. The state surveillance system is no longer receiving data from MCHD. The Policy Group has been notified per C15 and C12.
keyFacts: MCHD-INT01 and IIS export interface (10.72.14.22) are now isolated from the county network.
The IIS export file is officially 'not trusted' and must not be used for state reporting.
The Epi team must now operate solely from paper records and DOC laptops on LTE hotspots.
KDHE is no longer receiving data from MCHD; new case reports must be received via phone or email.
The Policy Group has been formally notified per C15 and C12.
fields.expectedAction: The Incident Commander must now activate paper mode and confirm that all frontline teams are operating under C3 procedures. All public messaging must align with the CERC plan.
